Eleanor (Customer): Hi, hitting intermittent 500s on /v1/generate from our production app. Example response has request_id=01H9ZQK7J2X4A0M8C3Y2Z7D5, timestamp 2024-11-21T18:07:12Z. Any idea?
Mia (Support): Sorry you're seeing that — we'll dig in. Can you share the full request_id and a quick curl repro you used? Also which region? :magnifying_glass_tilted_right:
Eleanor (Customer): Full request id above. Region: us-west-2. Here's the curl we used:
```
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk.REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"open-llama-7b", "input":"summarize this"}'
```
Mia (Support): Thanks. Alex (SRE) can you attempt a log lookup for request_id=01H9ZQK7J2X4A0M8C3Y2Z7D5 in us-west-2 prod?
Alex (SRE): Looking now. Quick note: prod primary log index retention is 30 days for parsed logs; raw debug bundles are kept 90 days on request. If this event is older than 30d we might need a debug bundle from the customer.
Alex (SRE): Query I'm running (Datadog-style):
```
@request_id:01H9ZQK7J2X4A0M8C3Y2Z7D5 service:redwood-inference env:prod region:us-west-2
```
Alex (SRE): Also trying a kibana/loki grep fallback on the host: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -n prod | grep 01H9ZQK7J2X4A0M8C3Y2Z7D5`
Alex (SRE): Found one partial entry but HTTP code is 502 from our edge LB, not a 500 internal:
```
2024-11-21T18:07:12.123Z service=edge request_id=01H9ZQK7J2X4A0M8C3Y2Z7D5 method=POST path=/v1/generate status=502 upstream_status=504 latency_ms=1204
```
Raj (Eng Runtime): 502/504 from upstream indicates our serving nodes timed out talking to model backend (KV cache or runtime). Can you repro with `X-Request-ID` header so we can tie client->edge->runtime logs? Example: `-H "X-Request-ID: 01H9ZQK7J2X4A0M8C3Y2Z7D5"` in the curl.
Mia (Support): Eleanor — can you re-run the curl with that header and add `--trace-ascii curl.trace` and attach the trace? That gives us client side and timing. If you can't attach full key, mask it.
Eleanor (Customer): Sure, will run now and attach trace. Also curious about retention — the event is ~3 days old. Should be within 30 days.
Alex (SRE): Good; 3 days is within retention. The initial partial hit might be at the edge only — need the header to correlate to runtime logs. If you can re-run, please include the full response/headers and the `X-Request-ID`.
Raj (Eng Runtime): If you prefer, you can also set `REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1` or `LOG_LEVEL=debug` in your client env and capture the SDK log bundle. That will include the raw HTTP exchange and any retry/backoff behavior.
Mia (Support): To speed up, if you can't reproduce, we can also pull associated traces by timestamp window. Alex — what search window do you want?
Alex (SRE): Give me a +/− 1 minute window around 2024-11-21T18:07:12Z. My Datadog query: `@timestamp:[2024-11-21T18:06:12 TO 2024-11-21T18:08:12] service:redwood-* request_id:01H9ZQK7J2X4A0M8C3Y2Z7D5`
Alex (SRE): Also checking internal router timeouts: `kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=router -o wide` then `kubectl logs router-... | grep 01H9ZQK7J2X4A0M8C3Y2Z7D5`
Mia (Support): If logs are missing at runtime and edge shows only 502, we might be dealing with an upstream OOM or preemption. Raj, please check GPU node churn events for that window.
Raj (Eng Runtime): On it. Running: `gcloud logging read 'resource.labels.cluster_name="inference-prod" AND timestamp>="2024-11-21T18:06:00Z" AND timestamp<="2024-11-21T18:08:30Z"' --project=redwood-prod`
Alex (SRE): Found relevant runtime trace: `runtime timed out waiting for model response after 1200ms` and a correlated `container restart` on pod inference-xyz 18:07:13Z. That explains the 504 upstream and 502 at edge.
Mia (Support): Summary for the customer: upstream runtime timeout caused the edge 502/504. We need the reproduction with `X-Request-ID` and the curl trace so we can get full end-to-end traces and any SDK retries on your side. Also please include whether you saw any client retries.
Eleanor (Customer): Re-ran with header and attached `curl.trace` (uploaded). Also saw a single 504 then a retry that succeeded after 1s. Trace attached and I left the exact timestamps.
Alex (SRE): Got the trace — correlates to runtime container restart. I've escalated to eng-runtime to investigate OOM/restart cause.
Raj (Eng Runtime): Thanks — I'm investigating memory spikes. If we need more we may ask you to enable the SDK debug bundle for one repro so we can collect request/response bodies.
Mia (Support): Thanks everyone. Eleanor — we'll follow up in this thread once eng-runtime has root cause and mitigation plan. :white_check_mark:
